items.title: New menu and 110 cosmetics
items.text: A redesigned menu with a side rail, search and favorites, plus 30 more cosmetics.
changes: New menu: side rail, page titles and search
Favorite your mods with the heart - they stay on top
Cosmetics store: big cards with real cape artwork
20 new capes and 10 new trails - 110 cosmetics in total

items.title: Waypoints
items.text: Press N to mark a spot and see its name and distance on screen.
changes: Press N to drop a waypoint where you stand
Name and distance on screen, edge markers when it's behind you
A Death waypoint where you last died
Saved per server, world and dimension
Rename, recolor, hide or delete them

items.title: 80 cosmetics
items.text: 30 capes, 17 trails and 23 accessories - every cape is now its own cosmetic.
changes: 30 capes, each its own cosmetic (Galaxy, Lava, Aurora, Vaporwave, Dark Matter and more)
17 trails: stars, hearts, soul flame, enchant, totem, firework and more
23 accessories: beanie, cowboy hat, wizard hat, headphones, sunglasses, scarf, jetpack and more
New cosmetics menu: grid with categories

items.title: One-click installer
items.text: BoogerInstaller.exe, automatic Booger Client updates with rollback, Safe Mode and clearer errors.
changes: Install like any Windows app, with Start Menu and Desktop shortcuts
Booger Client updates itself, verified, with one-click rollback
Safe Mode and Repair when something goes wrong
Automatic memory, and Java 21 managed for you

items.title: Booger online
items.text: The Booger logo shows next to Booger players, and colored badges for the team.
changes: Booger logo next to Booger players in the tab list and name tags
Badges color your name and logo
In-game announcements

items.title: Cosmetics that move with you
items.text: Cape physics, reactive wings, trails, loadouts and favorite emotes.
changes: Cape physics: Off, Simple, Smooth and Advanced
Wings react to sprinting, jumping, falling and flying
Trails: stars, hearts, embers, snow and more
Cosmetic loadouts and categories
Favorite and recent emotes

items.title: A cleaner look
items.text: New design everywhere, themes, notifications and a hold-to-pick emote wheel.
changes: New icons and calmer menu design
Themes: Booger Dark, Pure Black, Midnight
Notifications for keybinds and screenshots
Emote wheel: hold B, point, release

items.title: Booger Performance
items.text: Performance tab, frame-time graph, Dynamic FPS, presets and Sodium support.
changes: Performance presets and Adaptive Performance
Frame-time graph and live stats
Dynamic FPS and Distance Culling

items.title: Booger Client V20
items.text: Low Fire, Low Shield, 6 cape designs, Top Hat, Devil Horns and Fox Tail.
changes: New: Low Fire - lowers the burning overlay
New: Low Shield - lowers your shield in first person
Fixed: Booger Cape was hidden for most players
New: 6 cape designs (Booger Logo, Slime Drip, Galaxy, Flame, Midnight, Rainbow)
New cosmetics: Top Hat, Devil Horns, Fox Tail

items.title: Emotes 2.0
items.text: 19 emotes with smooth blending, whole-body motion and a paged emote wheel.
changes: 19 emotes including Backflip, Spin, Sit, Robot and Jumping Jacks
Emotes blend in and out smoothly
Whole-body motion: jumps, spins and flips
Paged emote wheel with 1-8 quick picks

items.title: Player Pet
items.text: A mini player that walks beside you, wearing your skin or any username's skin.
changes: New: Player Pet - type any username to change its skin
Fixed: the cosmetics list now scrolls

items.title: Emotes, Pet Morph and more
items.text: First emotes, Pet Morph, Booger Cape and Bunny Ears.
changes: New: Emote wheel (B)
New: Pet Morph - turn into animals
New cosmetics: Booger Cape, Bunny Ears
Halo sparkles and a blinking Shoulder Slime

items.title: Profiles and new modules
items.text: Profiles, Potion Effects, Combo Counter, Reach Display, Crosshair, Freelook and Auto Respawn.
changes: New: Profiles tab
New modules: Potion Effects, Combo Counter, Reach Display, Crosshair, Freelook, Auto Respawn
New cosmetics: Slime Halo, Slime Crown, Shoulder Slime

items.title: Booger Client V15
items.text: Rebuilt for 1.21.11 with a new menu, a full HUD editor and every module working.
changes: New Right Shift menu
Full HUD editor
Real 3D Neon Slime Wings
All HUD modules fixed for 1.21.11
